agyos_skill.instructions: Programmatic video assembly and audio post-production engine for local shell workflows. Replaces manual graphical timeline tasks with deterministic, reproducible FFmpeg commands. YouTube normalizes all video audio to **-14 LUFS integrated loudness** with a **-1.0 dB True Peak ceiling**. Audio mastered outside this target gets dynamically lowered by the YouTube platform, causing uneven volume across videos. Pass 1: Measure current audio profile ```bash ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.0:LRA=11:print_format=json -f null - ``` Pass 2: Apply linear normalization with measured parameters ```bash ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.0:LRA=11:\ measured_I=-21.4:\ measured_TP=-3.2:\ measured_LRA=9.1:\ measured_thresh=-32.0:\ offset=0.2 \ -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 192k output_normalized.mp4 ``` Automatically attenuates background music by 18dB whenever narration is active using sidechain compression: ```bash ffmpeg -i voiceover.wav -i background_music.mp3 -filter_complex \ "[1:a]volume=0.35[music_base]; \ [music_base][0:a]sidechaincompress=threshold=0.08:ratio=6:attack=20:release=300[ducked_music]; \ [0:a][ducked_music]amix=inputs=2:duration=first:dropout_transition=2[aout]" \ -map "[aout]" -c:a aac -b:a 192k mixed_audio.mp4 ``` Detects and strips dead air pauses longer than 400 milliseconds from talking head or screen recordings:
